articles.summary: The first physical edition of the Dungeon Crawler Carl books was a paperback version that Matt Dinniman self-published alongside the eBook. The series
articles.body:
The first physical edition of the Dungeon Crawler Carl books was a paperback version that Matt Dinniman self-published alongside the eBook. The series didn't get an actual hardcover edition until more recently, following the publishing rights being acquired by Penguin Random House in 2024. The first official hardcover was released in August 2024. The latest book, A Parade of Horribles , was the first in the series to get all formats released at once.

In addition to the standard hardcovers, there's also a Deluxe Edition of the first book up for preorder. It officially releases on November 17, 2026 and will likely be followed by other Deluxe Editions later on. Here are the official details from the product page:

A stunning cover and artwork by acclaimed artist Victo Ngai

A fully illustrated hardcover case featuring a solvable maze

Illustrations on the inside of the jacket

A 4-color printed ribbon marker featuring Carl and Donut on the run

A Q&A with author Matt Dinniman, conducted by GC, BWR, NW Princess Donut the Queen Anne Chonk herself

If you're looking to buy the Dungeon Crawler Carl hardcover editions, you should be able to find them available at pretty much any online bookstore . The popularity of the series means you should be able to find copies at your local bookstore or Barnes & Noble as well. If you're looking for the overall best place to get a discount, Amazon is the way to go.

The best time to buy books in general is when Amazon has some sort of special promotion. The most recent example of this is the '3 for 2' sale on books the retailer offered for Prime Day 2026 , which included almost all of the DCC hardcovers.

articles.title: Doctor Doom Is Not a Tony Stark Variant in Avengers: Doomsday, Confirms Kevin Feige
articles.summary: Kevin Feige has confirmed that Doctor Doom is not a variant of Tony Stark in Avengers: Doomsday.
articles.body:
Kevin Feige has confirmed that Doctor Doom is not a variant of Tony Stark in Avengers: Doomsday .

When speaking with Empire Magazine, Marvel Studios boss Kevin Feige debunked the popular fan theory that Doctor Doom and Tony Stark have a shared connection in the multiverse. Fans have speculated that Doom is a "variant" of Stark, since Robert Downey Jr. plays both characters . Variants are other versions of a character across the multiverse. We've seen this with the three Spider-Men, Wolverine, and Loki, so naturally, some fans thought this may all be an elaborate way to explain how Robert Downey Jr. is also playing Doom... turns out, it's not.

“Is Steve Rogers a Johnny Storm variant?" asked Feige. "People wondered, ‘Is Doom just a variant of another character? Is this just a shortcut to bringing back another character?’ The answer is no. He’s Victor Von Doom.”

Avengers: Doomsday Trailer: First Look at Doctor Doom

As for what Doom's whole deal is, the creative team behind the film teased what kind of energy he brings and why he is the way he is. The Russo Brothers, who are directing the film, teased that Doom has lost a child, is a "victim of trauma" and has a greater ego than Thanos. They also noted that he's a pretty terrifying presence.

"Doom is a Gothic character,” said director Joe Russo. “He says, ‘Hell answers to me,’ and he’s not kidding. He’s a very powerful character with some very dark magic, and he’s not above selling his soul to get what he wants. He’s worth being scared of.”

Robert Downey Jr. also noted that he was excited to lean into being a villain this time around, and suggested that Doom's plans have a tremendous scope to them.

"I like a bit of scorched earth,” teases Downey Jr. “Whatever you think he may be entertaining, I would ten times it, and you’ll probably be closer to the ballpark."

There's still a lot that we don't know about the film, which is just a little over a month away from being released. A recent listing on the WGA's website credited Hugh Jackman and Ryan Reynolds for contributing to the film's script, which seems to suggest Wolverine and Deadpool may be in the film . Additionally, Marvel confirmed earlier this week that Scarlet Witch will also return in Avengers: Doomsday , though seemingly under the control of Doom himself.

Avengers: Doomsday hits theaters on December 18.

Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team. He covers all things entertainment, including gaming, film, and more. You can find him on Twitter @Cade_Onder.

articles.title: The Massive 77" LG Evo C5 4K OLED TV Drops to $1,682 With Free Delivery Ahead of Black Friday
articles.body:

And among OLED TV brands, I wouldn't recommend any over LG now that it has dropped in price for Black Friday. Walmart is offering the massive 77" LG Evo C5 4K OLED Smart TV for just $1,682.03 with free delivery. The seller "Brandsmart" is an authorized LG reseller.

77" LG Evo C5 4K OLED TV Drops to $1,682 Ahead of Black Friday

LG's C-series OLED TV has long been one of our favorite TVs for console gaming . It's also one of the best TVs you can get for streaming 4K HDR content in its intended glory. The C5 is a 2025 model with image quality nearly identical to the current generation C6. It boasts the near-infinite black levels, near-infinite contrast ratio, and near-instantaneous response times you'd expect from any OLED TV. It's also equipped with LG's proprietary Evo panel, which is significantly brighter and offers a wider color gamut than traditional W-OLED TVs.

The C5 is equipped with modern gaming features that make it a perfect complement to current generation consoles like the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X, including a native 120Hz panel that can be pushed to as high as 144Hz, HDMI 2.1 inputs, variable refresh rate and auto low latency mode.

articles.title: The Game Awards 2026 are Coming to Disney+
articles.summary: This year’s Game Awards are coming to Disney+, where it will broadcast in addition to its usual streams on Twitch and YouTube.
articles.body:
This year’s Game Awards are coming to Disney+, where it will broadcast in addition to its usual streams on Twitch and YouTube.

This partnership with Disney comes as the media monolith seeks to promote its roster of video games and game-related media projects, which Kingdom Hearts fans will note comes right on the heels of its big KH4 reveal at D23 earlier this year.

Reports from Variety state that this packed slate includes Disney Twisted-Wonderland: The Animation, as well as Death Stranding Isolations , the forthcoming anime series based on Hideo Kojima’s Death Stranding franchise. The show got its first proper trailer in late October, alongside a first look at a full-length anime film set in the Death Stranding universe, Mosquito , which is set for a theatrical release on an as-yet unannounced date.

There are already a slew of strong contenders for this year’s Game Awards, the bulk of which you can read on IGN’s Biggest Games of 2026 Playlist . Resident Evil 9, 007: First Light, and The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake are just a few of the heavy hitters in an already packed slate — not to mention GTA 6, which will qualify for the Awards by the skin of its teeth after its arrival on November 19.

This marks the first time The Game Awards has been offered on Disney+, which continues to expand its reach after snagging Amazon’s Prime Video last year. The program will also stream on its official profiles on Twitch, YouTube, Instagram Live, TikTok, Steam, Twitter/X, Facebook, and Kick.

Somewhat ironically, the TGAs will take place at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles. The show will air on Thursday, December 10 at 7:30pm ET / 4:30pm PT and will be hosted by Geoff Keighley.

Kingdom Hearts 4 Extended Gameplay Trailer | D23 2026

The Game Awards is always rife with exciting news, reveals, performances, and sometimes, even drama, as seen last year when comedian Andrew Schulz ruffled some feathers after calling out the cast of the Mortal Kombat movie . With some big games having already been announced, like Resident Evil: Veronica and The Witcher 4 , fans are more hopeful than ever that they'll get to see more of these titles at the year's most prestigious game awards event.

Nominees for The Game Awards are determined by a jury of more than 100 media outlets, journalists, and creators, including IGN. Winners are selected by vote, comprised of 90% voting jury and 10% fan votes .

Virginia (she/her) is IGN’s News Editor. With ten years of experience reporting on games and entertainment, she’s got a storied background in the fighting game community, influencer news, and viral online trends. Find her on Twitter at @TheeMissGlaze .

articles.summary: Echo Gem is an Item in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake. This a new item, and serves as a replacement for the Stone of Agony and Shard of Agony from
articles.body:
Echo Gem is an Item in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake. This a new item, and serves as a replacement for the Stone of Agony and Shard of Agony from the other versions of the game. Rather than detecting grottos, Echo Gem detects Gold Skulltulas.

Reward for collecting 20 Gold Skulltula Tokens and speaking to the Cursed Rich Man at the Kakariko Village Spider House.

When equipped, an icon pings and flashes when a Gold Skulltula is nearby.

articles.title: Lenses of Truth Location - The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Lenses of Truth is an Item in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake. This is an updated version of the Lens of Truth from the original game.
articles.body:
Lenses of Truth is an Item in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake. This is an updated version of the Lens of Truth from the original game.

Learn more about the Lenses of Truth below.

Found in the Bottom of the Well dungeon. Must have learned Song of Storms as Adult Link and completed Forest Temple to return to the Young Link timeline. Play Song of Storms at the Kakariko Village Windmill to access the Well.

Used to see through fake walls, and see certain secrets (such as cheating at the Castle Town Treasure Chest mini-game).

articles.title: The Dungeon Crawler Carl Books and Graphic Novels Are on Sale Before Black Friday
articles.body:
The Dungeon Crawler Carl series has really made the rounds this year. If you haven't already read the books or listened to the audiobooks , you've likely had someone recommend that you do. Matt Dinniman's crazy LitRPG story has already become a full-blown franchise in 2026 and we haven't even gotten the TV series yet.

Whether you've already read the books or not, Amazon is running a great sale right now that can help you collect all of the hardcovers at a significant discount. It's not Black Friday yet, but this '3 for 2's sale is the best time to buy the full collection at once.

Buy 2, Get 1 Free Dungeon Crawler Carl Hardcovers

Dungeon Crawler Carl, Vol. 1 (Graphic Novel)

Dungeon Crawler Carl, Vol. 2 (Graphic Novel)

Amazon has consistently been the best place to buy these books over the last few years and it's largely thanks to these types of sales. The '3 for 2' sale is stackable, so you can add any multiple of three to your cart and Amazon will discount the price of the cheapest items from your cart at checkout. Since there have only been eight books in the series so far, that means you'll need to add one more book to your cart to fully take advantage of this discount. Thankfully, both of the Dungeon Crawler Carl graphic novels are also included in the promotion.

As someone who has read the books and the graphic novels, I can honestly say they are both worth checking out. I was pretty worried I wouldn't like the graphic novel since I read the books before checking it out, but I was pleasantly surprised how different it felt. I gave it an 8 out of 10 in my review if you want to check that out.

Amazon's Black Friday Audible deal is great for the audiobook versions

Get 3 Months of Audible Standard for $0.99/mo

The '3 for 2' sale is great for fans who are looking for some merch to add to their shelves, but the Black Friday Audible deal is better for newcomers. The popularity of Dungeon Crawler Carl is, in no small part, thanks to some absolutely terrific audiobooks. Matt Dinniman himself has praised Jeff Hays' performance , saying he's one of the few narrators out there doing all of the voices and sound effects that make audiobooks more than just narration. The DCC audio versions are undoubtedly some of the best audiobooks available right now .

If you're new to the series, or just want to see what the audiobook hype is about, Amazon is running an Audible promo that's worth checking out. New (and some previous) subscribers can get the Audible Standard plan for only $0.99/month for the first three months, which includes one book per month. You'll also get a bonus $20 Audible credit to spend anything you want.

Jacob Kienlen is a Senior Audience Development Strategist and Writer for IGN. Born and raised in Portland, Oregon, he has considered the Northwest his home for his entire life. With a bachelor's degree in communication and 10 years of professional writing experience, his expertise is spread across a variety of different pop culture topics — from TV series to books and the latest LEGO sets .
